svg.aria-label: x^\mu = \left({{\partial x^\mu}\over{\partial x^{\mu'}}}\right)_p x^{\mu'} + {1\over 2} \left({{\partial^2 x^\mu}\over {\partial x^{\mu_1'}\partial x^{\mu_2'}}}\right)_p x^{\mu_1'}x^{\mu_2'} + {1\over 6} \left({{\partial^3 x^\mu}\over {\partial x^{\mu_1'}\partial x^{\mu_2'}\partial x^{\mu_3'}}}\right)_p x^{\mu_1'}x^{\mu_2'}x^{\mu_3'} +\cdots\ , \tag{2.36}
